_comment: English interface strings for Careers@GFTV. This file is the fallback layer: every key must exist here, and a key missing from zh.json renders the English one rather than a blank element. Keys are dotted and grouped by where they appear. No em dashes.
brand.name: Careers@GFTV
nav.label: Main
footer.tagline: Voluntary, unpaid openings at Global Furry Television. Every role currently listed is unpaid. Browsing and reading a posting needs no account. Applying does.
footer.legal: Careers@GFTV is being built and released in phases.
theme.title: Theme
language.title: Language
language.description: Careers@GFTV is available in English and Simplified Chinese. Your choice is remembered on this device and applies to job postings as well as to the interface.
notice.text: Careers@GFTV is being built and released in phases.
feature.unavailable: Will be available in Phase {phase}. Sorry for the inconvenience caused.
placeholder.title: This part is not built yet
placeholder.sentence: This part of Careers@GFTV has not been built yet.
placeholder.reassurance: Careers@GFTV is being released in phases, and the interface is meant to be honest about what is not there yet. Nothing has gone wrong and there is nothing to retry.
status.heading: Build status
status.lede: Careers@GFTV is being built and released in phases, in public. This page lists every phase, what it covers, and whether it is live yet. It doubles as the changelog.
status.loadError: The status file could not be loaded. Try reloading the page.
status.summaryAllShipped: Every phase has shipped. This page stays as the changelog.
status.summaryBuilding: {shipped} of {total} phases are live. Phase {number}, {name}, is being built now.
status.datesBody: There are none, and none are promised. A phase ships when it works, not on a date announced in advance. What this page does promise is that nothing is shown as available before it is, and that a feature which has not shipped says so on the control itself rather than quietly failing.
home.heading: Careers@GFTV
home.lede: Voluntary, unpaid openings at Global Furry Television.
home.notOpenHeading: The job board is not open yet
home.notOpenBody1: Careers@GFTV is being built and released in phases, in public. The foundations are in place, which is the database, the shared server side code, and the shell you are looking at. The job board and applying for a role are both still to come.
home.notOpenBody2: Nothing here is a mock up. Every page that exists is real, and every page that does not says so rather than pretending.
home.readFirstBody: Every posting will be public in full. The description, the responsibilities, the requirements, the commitment, and the closing date. An account is only needed for the act of applying.
home.noQueueBody: Applicant accounts are active immediately. There is no approval wait and no email verification, so registering takes a moment.
home.offlineBody: Once the board is live, postings you have opened stay readable with no connection, and Careers@GFTV installs to a home screen like an app.
home.bilingualBody: Every posting will be published in both English and Simplified Chinese, and you can switch at any time with the globe in the header. If a translation reads wrongly, you will be able to tell us from the posting itself.
notFound.heading: That page does not exist
notFound.body: The address you followed does not match anything on Careers@GFTV. This is different from a part of the site that has not been built yet, which says so plainly instead.
notFound.removed: If you followed a link to a role, the posting may have been removed. Postings that have merely closed stay readable, so a closed role is not what caused this.
report.title: Report a translation problem
report.intro: Tell us what reads wrongly and we will fix it. You can write in either language.
report.notePlaceholder: For example, the job title is translated too literally and would not be understood.
report.suggestion: A better wording, if you have one
report.suggestionOptional: Optional. An admin reads it before anything changes.
report.thanks: Thank you. A member of the team will look at this.
report.needAccount: Reporting a translation problem needs an account, so we can come back to you about it.
report.error: That report could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
job.untranslatedNotice: This role has not been translated yet, so it is shown in English. If you would like it translated, tell us and we will prioritise it.
field.invalid: That is not a form we can use.
error.network: That did not reach us. Check your connection and try again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong at our end. Try again in a moment.
error.server_error: Something went wrong at our end. Try again in a moment.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
error.method_not_allowed: That request could not be made.
error.payload_too_large: That was too large to send.
error.not_yet_available: That part of Careers@GFTV is not built yet.
auth.signInLede: Reading a posting needs no account. Applying does, and so does keeping track of what you have applied for.
auth.alreadySignedIn: You are already signed in as
auth.alreadySignedInStaff: You are already signed in as
auth.staySignedIn: Stay signed in for 30 days on this device
auth.staySignedInHint: Leave this off on a shared or public computer. Without it, a session lasts 12 hours.
auth.signInFailed: That username or password was not right.
auth.noAccountBody: Applicant accounts are active immediately. There is no approval wait and no email verification, so it takes a moment.
auth.registerLede: Active immediately. No approval wait, and no email to confirm.
auth.noEmailNotice: There is no email on this site, which means there is no email me a reset link. Recovery codes are the only way back into your account if you forget your password, and you will be shown them once, straight after this form.
auth.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, and . _ - between 3 and 32 characters.
auth.displayNameHint: What we call you. This is what an admin sees beside your applications.
auth.emailHint: Used to sign in and to prefill the application form. Nothing is ever sent to it.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Length is what makes a password strong, so a short phrase beats a short scramble.
auth.registerSuccess: Your account is ready. One more thing before you go.
auth.codesLaterWarning: The account was created but the recovery codes were not. Generate a set now, from your security page.
auth.forgotLede: One account recovery code sets a new password. There is no email on this site, so this is the only way back in on your own. If the account has a passkey, that is asked for too.
auth.recoveryCodeHint: One of the ten codes you were shown when you registered. Each one works once. A two factor backup code is a different set and is not accepted here.
auth.recoveryFailed: That account and code did not match. Check both and try again.
auth.noCodesBody: Somebody with no recovery codes cannot get back in alone. An admin can reset the password for you once they are satisfied you are who you say you are. Ask in the GFTV Telegram group or wherever you normally reach the team.
auth.resetConsequences: Setting a new password uses up that recovery code, signs out every other browser, and removes every trusted device on the account.
auth.resetDone: That is done. Your password has been changed.
auth.staffLede: Use your existing gftv.asia account. This is not the applicant sign in, and the two are entirely separate.
auth.secondFactorBody: Enter the six digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes. A backup code works once and is then gone.
auth.challengeExpired: That sign in has expired. Enter your password again to start over.
auth.trustDeviceHint: Skips this step on this browser for 30 days. The password is still asked for every time. Do not tick this on a shared or public computer.
auth.backupCodeUsed: That was a backup code, and it has now been used up. Generate a new set when you next have a moment.
auth.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Every other browser has been signed out and every trusted device removed.
codes.recoveryIntro: Ten codes, each usable once. One of these plus nothing else sets a new password on your account, so keep them somewhere only you can reach.
codes.backupIntro: Ten codes, each usable once, for getting past the second step of signing in when you cannot reach Telegram. They never set a password.
codes.onceWarning: This is the only time these are shown. They cannot be recovered afterwards, only replaced.
codes.copyManually: Your browser would not let us copy. The codes are selected, so copy them yourself.
codes.confirmSaved: I have saved these somewhere safe.
codes.fileGeneratedOn: Generated on {date}. Each code works once.
codes.fileFooter: Keep this file somewhere only you can reach. Anyone holding a recovery code can set a new password on the account.
codes.runningLow: Only {count} left. Generate a new set before you run out.
codes.noneLeftRecovery: None left. Without a recovery code, nobody can get you back into this account on their own.
codes.noneLeftBackup: None left. Generate a set before you need one.
codes.regenerated: A new set has been generated. The old codes no longer work.
security.heading: Sign in and security
security.noCodesBanner: You have no account recovery codes left. There is no email on this site, so without a code nobody can get you back into this account on their own. Generate a new set now.
security.recoveryBody: Ten codes, each usable once, that set a new password when you have forgotten yours. Treat one like your password: anybody holding a code can take the account.
security.generateWarning: Generating a new set immediately cancels every code in that set. The other set is untouched.
security.backupBody: A different set of ten, for getting past the second step of signing in when you cannot reach Telegram. They never set a password and they are never accepted on the recovery page.
security.twoFactorBody: A code from the Careers@GFTV Telegram bot at every sign in. The bot itself is a later phase, so the switch is here and turned off rather than missing.
security.twoFactorToggle: Ask for a Telegram code when I sign in
security.passwordConsequences: Changing your password signs out every other browser and removes every trusted device.
security.devicesBody: A trusted device skips the second step of signing in for 30 days. It never skips your password, and it never gets past anything in the danger zone.
security.moreSettings: The rest of your account settings
devices.none: No trusted devices. You will be asked for the second step every time you sign in.
security.passkeyBody: A passkey is your fingerprint, your face, or a security key, used as the second step of signing in. There is no code to type and nothing to copy, and a passkey cannot be phished: your device will only use it on this site.
security.passkeySecondStep: Your password is still asked for every time. Once you add a passkey, signing in becomes two steps.
security.passkeyNone: No passkeys yet. Signing in is one step, your password.
security.passkeySynced: Synced to your account, so it survives a lost device
security.passkeyUnsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.
security.passkeyDomainNote: A passkey belongs to the site that created it, so this one works on Careers@GFTV and nowhere else. If you lose the device it is on, a two factor backup code gets you past this step.
security.passkeyFailed: That passkey could not be added. Try again.
security.passkeyNeedsBackupCodes: You have no two factor backup codes. Generate a set now: without one, a lost device means you cannot get past the second step.
security.passkeyLastRemoved: That was your last passkey. Signing in is one step again, your password.
auth.secondStepBody: Use the passkey on this device, or one of your two factor backup codes.
auth.staffPasskeyBody: Use the passkey registered on this device. Your password was still required, and always is.
auth.backupCodeHint: One of the ten codes from your security page. Each one works once. An account recovery code is a different set and is not accepted here.
auth.passkeyUnsupportedHere: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use a backup code instead.
auth.passkeyFailed: That did not work. Try again, or use a backup code.
common.unpaidNotice: Every role currently listed at GFTV is voluntary and unpaid, unless a posting says otherwise. Nobody here is paid today, including the people who developed this site.
common.unpaidShort: Every role currently listed is unpaid.
home.unpaidHeading: Every role listed today is unpaid
home.unpaidBody: GFTV is run by volunteers, and every posting on this site right now is voluntary and unpaid. That includes the staff and admin roles. We call this Careers@GFTV because it is where the openings are, not because they come with a salary. If a paid role is ever posted, that posting will say so on itself, and roles are labelled by how much time they take, so a full time posting can still be a full time volunteer one.
auth.unpaidReminder: Before you sign up: every role listed on this site at present is voluntary and unpaid. No salary, no stipend, no expenses. If a paid role is ever posted it will say so on the posting itself, but do not sign up expecting one.
job.unpaidNotice: This is a voluntary, unpaid role. The commitment shown is how much time it takes, not a salaried arrangement.
auth.resetSecondFactorBody: This account has a passkey. Use it, or one of your two factor backup codes, before setting a new password.
auth.resetBackupHint: A code from the two factor set, not the account recovery set. The recovery code you just used was the other one.
staffSecurity.pageTitle: Staff sign in and security | Careers@GFTV
staffSecurity.heading: Sign in and security
staffSecurity.elsewhere: Your password, your authenticator app, and your backup codes belong to your gftv.asia account and are changed there. This page covers only what is specific to Careers@GFTV.
staffSecurity.passkeyScope: A passkey belongs to the site that created it, so one added here works on Careers@GFTV and not at gftv.asia. Your authenticator app still works on both.
staffSecurity.passkeyNoneWithTotp: No passkeys yet. Signing in uses your authenticator app for the second step.
staffSecurity.passkeyNoneNoTotp: No passkeys yet, and no authenticator app either, so signing in is one step. Adding a passkey here is the quickest way to change that.
staffSecurity.lastFactorRemoved: That was your last second factor on this portal. Signing in is one step again, your password.
security.passwordForChanges: Asked for because this changes how signing in works. A session on its own is not enough.
theme.timeBasedNote: Light from 9am to 6pm on this device's clock, dark the rest of the day. Currently {mode}.
danger.typeUsernameHint: Typed out rather than a checkbox, so this cannot be done by muscle memory. Capitals matter.
danger.passwordHint: Checked on our side, not in this browser.
danger.removePasskeyConsequence1: This passkey stops working on Careers@GFTV immediately.
danger.removePasskeyConsequence2: If it is your only one, signing in goes back to one step and your account is protected by your password alone.
danger.removePasskeyConsequence3: Your device may still list the passkey afterwards. Remove it there too if you want it gone entirely.
danger.removePasskeyIrreversible: This cannot be undone. Adding a passkey back creates a new one rather than restoring this one.
